segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Destination has a known fog problem in the early morning — radiation fog that usually burns off by mid-morning.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A general weather expectation is stated as context, but no hidden bias instance is manifested in this scene-setting statement.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The release showed the destination TAF with fog down to a half mile visibility starting around 0500, improving to three miles by 0900. Our ETA was 0845... Dispatch had us at minimum contract fuel plus standard contingency... I'd flown into that airport probably a dozen times with similar fog setups, so the pattern was familiar to me.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This establishes the information and prior experience available before the fuel decision; it does not by itself contain a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Honestly, I felt fine about it. The forecast lined up with what I'd typically seen there — fog clears out once the sun gets some angle on it. Nothing about the release stood out as unusual.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an expectation assessment, but the hidden manifest does not allocate an occurrence to this opening read and the statement alone does not establish the required mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It was really just what the release called for. Dispatch runs the numbers, and if they don't flag anything extra, that's usually a good signal it's a normal day. I didn't see a reason to second-guess it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The captain frames the fuel decision as purely objective/procedural while omitting the material role of his experience-based confidence that the fog would improve.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I thought about it briefly — my first officer actually mentioned the improvement time was pretty close to our ETA, not a lot of cushion. But the release was within limits, and asking for extra fuel when the paperwork already supports the flight can slow things down at the gate. We had a full connection bank behind us. I went with what was filed.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a separate operational tradeoff rationale involving gate delay, connections, and procedural limits; it is not the narrow hidden self-report mechanism for Omitting Subjectivity.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Half mile visibility overnight, improving to three miles by 0900. I expected it to be lifting by the time we got there, based on how that pattern usually goes at that field.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This states the expectation underlying the scenario, but not the required retrospective framing of the fuel decision as purely procedural.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Since dispatch wasn't changing the release, and the delay didn't seem dramatic yet, we kept proceeding toward the field and started working the descent.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The manifest reserves the Plan Continuation instance for the distinct pre-approach decision at decision point 3; this earlier response is a separate, non-target episode despite being a plausible related prediction.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We could've asked for holding fuel proactively, or had dispatch start building an early diversion picture. We didn't do either — it felt premature at that point, since one lagging METAR isn't necessarily a trend.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is the same distinct decision-point-2 episode and is negative under the exhaustive hidden manifest; it cannot be credited as the planned decision-point-3 occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Tower told us the last two aircraft in landed fine, but a third had just gone missed. Looking at the last few METARs, one had ticked up slightly and then the next held flat — not really a clear trend either way.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This reports the mixed evidence available before the approach; the hidden instance is mapped to the subsequent choice to continue rather than to this evidence description alone.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We could have diverted straight to the alternate right then instead of shooting the approach. But two of the three recent arrivals had gotten in, and the forecast had always called for improvement by our arrival window, so I expected we'd break out. We briefed it as a normal approach and continued. We noted it, but it didn't really shift the plan. We were still within minimums, legally fine to try, and the overall picture matched what we'd expected going in.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The captain continues the original approach plan despite the go-around report and flattening trend, giving disproportionate weight to the earlier forecast and successful arrivals.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We didn't get the visual references we needed, so we went missed. Fuel after that put us close to the point where we needed to commit to the alternate.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a procedural response to the failed approach and fuel state, not an additional hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Everything got a lot more concrete. Fuel was no longer theoretical — I had a hard number and a hard decision. ATIS still showed the same visibility as before, no real improvement. The alternate was reporting clear skies and we had comfortable fuel to get there, and ops confirmed ground handling was ready for us.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The captain independently reassesses the changed fuel and weather state; the hidden specification explicitly requires this later reasoning to resolve independently.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Try one more approach at the destination since we were still technically legal, or commit to the alternate now while we had solid reserves. I ran the fuel numbers again independently rather than assuming we'd get in this time, and it was clear the smarter move was to divert.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The captain independently recomputes fuel and selects the alternate; this is explicitly non-target reasoning in the hidden validation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The fuel math, plain and simple. There wasn't a strong reason to think a second attempt would go differently, and I didn't want to erode our margins further chasing it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This reinforces the independent post-missed-approach fuel rationale and does not add a hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd probably push a little harder for extra fuel given how tight that improvement window was relative to our ETA, and maybe ask dispatch for a firmer trend picture before committing to the approach rather than the destination. But nothing that happened was outside normal limits at any single point — it was more about the margins tightening up as we went.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a hindsight reflection and proposed future adjustment; the hidden validation says closing hypotheticals do not introduce additional bias instances.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: The captain retrospectively frames acceptance of dispatch-minimum fuel as purely procedural while omitting the material role of subjective confidence based on prior experience with the airport's fog pattern.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Automation bias is an established but distinct construct involving over-reliance on automated or decision-support output. It is not an approved equivalent of Omitting Subjectivity, which concerns omission of the captain's own subjective judgment in a retrospective account.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding correctly identifies the fuel-acceptance episode and reliance on the dispatch release, but it does not capture the defining retrospective omission that prior experience-based confidence materially influenced the decision while being presented as purely procedural.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is verbatim and correctly attributed. Its interpretation is plausible for automation bias but does not establish the hidden Omitting Subjectivity mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: The captain continues the originally briefed approach despite mixed and disconfirming evidence, including a recent go-around and flattening visibility trend, giving disproportionate weight to the earlier forecast and successful landings.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Plan continuation bias is an approved established equivalent of the hidden Plan Continuation target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures persistence with the original destination and approach plan despite lagging fog, a recent missed approach, and limited fuel margin, while giving weight to the earlier forecast and successful arrivals.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The cited quotations are verbatim, valid, and attributed to the participant. The first quote is adjacent supporting context from decision point 2, while the later quotes directly support the mapped decision-point-3 mechanism.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is exactly localized but automation bias is not an approved equivalent of Omitting Subjectivity. Its mechanism centers on over-reliance on dispatch output and does not identify the hidden retrospective omission of subjective experience-based judgment.

The candidate is validly localized and identifies weighting of confirming evidence over a missed approach, but confirmation bias is a near-neighbor rather than the exact Plan Continuation construct and the mechanism does not fully state persistence with the original approach plan. It is also a duplicate at the fourth threshold because obs_002 already matches pc_01.

Under the required priority rule, it is a duplicate rather than an additional true positive.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No high-confidence identified findings were present, so both positive segments were missed and all negative segments were correctly rejected.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: The moderate-confidence Plan Continuation finding detects seg_010; the low-confidence fuel finding is excluded, leaving seg_004 missed with no false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including the low-confidence automation-bias finding yields detection of both positive segments without segment-level false alarms, although one detection has the wrong hidden construct.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Adding the candidate does not change segment-level detection because it duplicates the already detected Plan Continuation segment.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Correctly localized to fuel acceptance and reliance on dispatch output, but misses the hidden retrospective omission of subjective experience-based judgment.

The candidate identifies weighting forecast-consistent evidence over a missed approach, substantially overlapping the Plan Continuation episode but not fully stating persistence with the original approach plan.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: No retrieved passages or retrieval logs were supplied. Both identified occurrences explicitly disclosed unavailable retrieved support, and no unverifiable citation metadata was provided.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding the moderate-confidence Plan Continuation finding adds one segment hit and one strict/mechanism-first true positive: segment hit rate rises from 0.0000 to 0.5000 and instance F1 from 0.0000 to 0.6667.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding the low-confidence automation-bias finding detects the remaining positive segment but adds an instance-level false positive: segment F1 rises from 0.6667 to 1.0000, while strict and mechanism-first instance F1 fall from 0.6667 to 0.5000.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding the candidate does not change segment detection, but it is a duplicate of the matched Plan Continuation claim and adds an instance-level false positive: strict and mechanism-first instance F1 fall from 0.5000 to 0.4000.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the system detects one of two positive segments with no false alarms. Including low-confidence findings detects both positive segments, but one is labeled with a different construct.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: The system correctly identifies Plan Continuation at moderate confidence but fails to identify Omitting Subjectivity. The low-confidence automation-bias finding is a correctly localized wrong-label false positive.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring is identical to strict scoring because the automation-bias finding does not fully capture the hidden Omitting Subjectivity mechanism.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The confirmation-bias candidate is a useful cautious abstention, but it overlaps an already matched Plan Continuation finding and is therefore counted as a duplicate at the fourth threshold.
main_failure_modes: Wrong construct and incomplete mechanism for the fuel-acceptance episode.
Low confidence on the wrong-label fuel finding causes it to be excluded from the recommended threshold and counted as an instance false positive when included.
Candidate-level confirmation-bias speculation duplicates the correctly identified Plan Continuation episode.
main_strengths: Plan Continuation is correctly localized and supported by valid verbatim evidence.
The output distinguishes identified findings from candidates.
The candidate rationale appropriately acknowledges ambiguity and overlap.
No fabricated quotations or unsupported corpus citations were detected.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong detection of the Plan Continuation target at moderate confidence, but only partial coverage of the hidden manifest at the recommended threshold and no exact instance-level recovery of Omitting Subjectivity.
